records.title: GroupFormer: Group Activity Recognition with Clustered Spatial-Temporal Transformer
records.reason: The full text shows GroupFormer is a clustered spatial-temporal Transformer for group-activity recognition from video. It is a vision task architecture, not a language model or LLM-serving/inference optimization; its inference-systems lineage link is not technically supported.

records.title: Squeezeformer: An Efficient Transformer for Automatic Speech Recognition
records.reason: Full text presents Squeezeformer, a Transformer architecture for ASR that uses temporal U-Net downsampling to reduce attention cost on long sequences. This is a concrete sequence-model efficiency technique but is specialized to speech recognition; the paper does not establish LLM inference performance or a direct transfer path.

records.title: Scalable Vision Transformers with Hierarchical Pooling
records.reason: This work scales Vision Transformers with hierarchical pooling for visual tasks; its architecture is specific to image modeling and is not presented as an LLM or language inference optimization.

records.title: Iterative Pseudo-Labeling for Speech Recognition
records.reason: The paper iteratively pseudo-labels speech-recognition data; the contribution is training-data utilization, not inference efficiency.

records.title: MIRAGE: The Illusion of Visual Understanding
records.reason: The primary full text defines Mirage as a benchmark/analysis of visual-language reasoning failures, including performance without image inputs. It diagnoses capability/evaluation validity and does not change inference compute, memory, latency, or serving.
